meta.title: Sell Front: your shop online, run from WhatsApp
meta.desc: A website and checkout for any business that takes orders, run from WhatsApp. ₹999 a month.
cover.sub: Build it, change it, run it. Or let us.
cover.line: A website and checkout for any business that takes orders, with every order and stock change run from the WhatsApp chat you already use.
feat.title: Everything a shop needs, from one chat
feat.1.b: Say what you sell on WhatsApp, reply BUILD; your shop is made in about three minutes
feat.2.b: Send a photo with its name as the caption; it is on the shop at once
feat.3.b: Each order arrives with Accept and Out of stock buttons
feat.4.b: UPI, card or cash on delivery; no buyer app, account or password
feat.5.b: “Make it festive for Diwali”: preview, publish, undo any time
feat.6.b: Stock by one line, GST invoices, own domain, CSV export
ctrl.title: Your shop, in your hands. Our team when you want it.
ctrl.a.title: Build and run it yourself
ctrl.a.1: Build it from one chat in minutes
ctrl.a.2: Add, edit or remove products any time
ctrl.a.3: Change prices, stock, offers and design
ctrl.a.4: Publish when you like; undo any change
ctrl.b.title: Or we set it up for you
ctrl.b.1: Send your catalogue, list or photos
ctrl.b.2: We bring in every product and collection
ctrl.b.3: We design it around your brand
ctrl.b.4: You check it and take over from there
